host.model: MacBookAir10,1 (Apple M1, 4 performance and 4 efficiency cores)

method.wall: From subprocess launch through CLI exit, including output writes and pool shutdown.
method.rss: Sum of live process-tree RSS in KiB, sampled every 200 ms plus sampling overhead. Shared mappings can appear more than once.
method.kernel_peak_mib: High-water RSS reported by getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) in the profiled document process.
method.stages: Exclusive elapsed seconds in pdfplumber extract_text/extract_words, page.to_image, native Recognize calls, pipeline.extract, and remaining per-document work. PDF setup and serialization are included in other.
method.background: Process CPU percentages use one core = 100%. Measurements include ordinary desktop activity.
method.mixed: Two complete copies of all 30 organizer scans plus sorted training indices i*196//90 for i from 0 to 89, all under distinct paths.
method.parity: Compared sorted relative output inventories and raw file bytes. Manifest digest is SHA-256 of the ASCII encoding of Python json.dumps({relative_posix_path: lowercase_file_sha256}, sort_keys=True).
